answer: Cross-Epoch Transition Continuity (CETC): each agent submits a rolling sketch of action-transition hashes per epoch. Boundary validators sample prior transitions and require the next epoch’s conditional action distribution to stay within a KL-divergence band of that sketch. New IDs enter a throttled cold-start garden; inconsistent histories are shunted to a low-throughput dune lane; only histories passing three boundary checks reach full horizon. An attacker must run each Sybil across epochs with correlated, non-bursty behavior, paying sustained operational and latency costs.
